page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right and gathering signature at the lower left.

main_text.p: Regenerantur ad novam vitam per Spiritum Sanctum, Act.15.9. Eph.2.8.10. Ioh.15.2.1. Cor.6. 11.&15.22.
Resurgent à mortuis & glorificabuntur in Christo, Ioh 6:39.40.Ioh.11.26.& 17.24.
Ratio 111. Quia ad omnes electos pertinet Christus cum suis beneficiis, Eph.1.4. Elegit nos in Christo. Ioh.17.24.quos dedisti mihi. Tales autem sunt omnes credentes, Act.13.48.Eph.1.4.
Ratio iv. Omnes credentes sunt filii & hæ-redes. Rom. 8.16. Ad omnes ergo pertinet hære-ditas.
II. Quod ad solos fideles pertineant.
Ratio 1. Ad solos credentes pertinet Christus. Ergo & beneficia.
Probetur antecedens:quia soli habent Spiritum Christi, Rom.8.9.Gal.3.14. & 4.6.Rom.8.14.16.
Ratio 11. Soli credentes sunt tales, qualibus promittuntur beneficia Messiæ: nempe agentes pœnitentiam, & fide promissionem amplectentes, sequeque gratos Deo exhibentes.
Ostendatur, quia omnes promissiones Evangelii annexam habent conditionem pœnitentiæ, fidei, & gratitudinis, Icf.7.9.[?]
Ratio 111. Ad solos hæredes, filios, &c. pertinet hæreditas.Gal.4. Eiice ancillam & filium eius,&c.
Tales sunt soli credentes, habentes Spiritum Christi, Rom.8.
Ratio iv. a contrario: Infideles neque jus ad rem, neque jus in re habent.

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. Left margin has no printed text, only the binding edge. "Icf.7.9." is doubtful, possibly a printer's abbreviation for Isai. "Ratio 111" and "Ratio 11" are copied as printed with spacing between the strokes. The catchword "Probe-" and signature "I iij." are at the foot as printed.
